chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: A visitor interrupts the Barker home interview
summary: A friend with a recent operation drops in, and Milt explains he is interviewing the Barkers about their years in show business.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: Mr. Gustoff(?) just had an operation.
Yeah. Prostate and (?), all kinds of things.
Well, I'm glad to see you up and around.
...we're just sitting here, and I'm interviewing Mrs. Barker and Danny Barker about some of the days that we spent in show business together.
You were in show business, huh?
Yes, sir. We were all in at the same time, and still are, you know. We all still are. We were talking about some of the days when we were young, and the places we went, and the things we did.
